text_block_list.text:
My second summer training camp with Gold City.
Unlike last year when she was so tense—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, once we drop our bags off,
can we head straight to the beach?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Right now, I have this crazy urge to run.
choice_data_list: In a good mood, are we?
In a good mood, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, in the Japan Cup,
I'll get to run against two absolute monsters.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I'm looking forward to.
I want to become a stronger me and win."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...If we keep talking about it, I seriously won't be able to take it anymore.
Let's go, Trainer!
—And so, our heated summer training camp began!
